summary: Customer A is currently classified as High Risk due to multiple early-warning signals, including a 38.6% revenue decline, consecutive negative cash flows, a 9.8% drop in collateral value, and 90 days past due. The customer operates in the Seafood industry, which is currently experiencing a downturn, and has a ring-fenced relationship with An Phat Garment Co., which is also past due.

findings.statement: Customer A has experienced a 38.6% drop in 90-day revenue compared to the baseline average.
The customer has reported negative net cash flow for two consecutive periods of -1392.1 and -658.1.
Collateral value for the machinery has decreased by 9.8% from its peak of 63761 to 57485.
The loan is currently 90 days past due.
The Seafood industry is in a downturn with a growth percentage of -7.9%.

recommended_actions.rationale: The loan is High Risk with 90 days past due and negative cash flow, requiring a suspension of disbursements per policy P-08.
Collateral value has dropped significantly, necessitating a request for additional collateral or a credit limit reduction per policy P-22.
The customer has triggered more than 3 early-warning signals, requiring monthly monitoring per policy P-17.

limitations: The credit officer should verify the current status of the ring-fenced relationship with An Phat Garment Co. and assess if the industry downturn is expected to persist, as this may impact the recovery of the collateral value.
